== Notes ==
* This skill is commonly used by [[bonder]] monks, with skills like [[Life Bond]] and [[Life Barrier]]. 
* Hero monks tend to spam this skill if they have less than maximum energy. This is at the expense of casting needed healing or protection prayers during heated battles. Consider disabling this skill before battling large mobs and activate the skill manually when energy is low.
